tasks.label: ci-reverify
tasks.command: Set-Location d:\RustProject\VeloGuard; flutter pub get 2>&1 | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $env:TEMP\vg-verify\pubget2.txt; flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile 2>&1 | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $env:TEMP\vg-verify\enforce2.txt; git diff --stat 2>&1 | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $env:TEMP\vg-verify\diffstat2.txt; flutter analyze 2>&1 | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $env:TEMP\vg-verify\analyze2.txt; flutter test 2>&1 | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $env:TEMP\vg-verify\test2.txt; Write-Output REVERIFY_DONE

tasks.label: ci-fix-push
tasks.command: $lines = @('Fix CI dependency resolution: align Flutter and Dart SDK with pubspec.lock', '', 'CI used Flutter 3.44.6 (Dart 3.10.4) while pubspec.lock was produced with Dart 3.13.2 and requires dart >= 3.12.0, so flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile could never succeed there. CI, release, and environment.sdk now agree on Flutter 3.47.2 and Dart ^3.12.0.'); $lines | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $env:TEMP\vg-verify\commitmsg.txt; Set-Location d:\RustProject\VeloGuard; git add .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/workflows/release.yml .vscode/tasks.json README.md README_EN.md pubspec.yaml; git commit -F $env:TEMP\vg-verify\commitmsg.txt 2>&1 | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $env:TEMP\vg-verify\commit.txt; git push origin main 2>&1 | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $env:TEMP\vg-verify\push.txt; Write-Output PUSH_DONE
